title: ReinforcedPumpkin
description: Plugin to convert helmets into customizable pumpkin items with preserved stats
body:
### Reinforced Pumpkin 
**allows you to convert any helmet into a special pumpkin-based item that fully preserves its vanilla armor stats, durability, and enchantments while enabling custom models and textures (CustomModelData)**

- **Right now work only on Paper 1.21.x backport or update maybe be later**
  ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/981143f5ce820cd920cba78a19b56cf96dcbc7cb.png)
  
Works with any helmets
